# Mixed-Methods Sociology Portfolio

Hello, I’m **Moustafa Basiony**, a mixed-methods sociologist and MSc Sociology candidate at KU Leuven.

I use quantitative, qualitative, and computational methods to study social inequality, migration, discrimination, intergroup relations, education, and wellbeing.

:::

::: {.callout-note}

## Methods at a glance

Survey research · regression analysis · machine learning · computational text analysis · web scraping
